add.note: plain plus; lightest of the set, acceptable

alarm-list.note: bell only; the list aspect comes from the context, not the glyph

device-connect.note: plug reads as connect; action, not a state

network.note: three-node graph reads as network or hierarchy

open-folder.note: folder shape reads clearly down to 16 px

pump.note: impeller triangle is tiny at 16 px; the base and outlet carry the meaning

save.note: classic floppy; inner details close up at 16 px but silhouette holds

settings.note: uses the explicit 16 px variant without diagonal rays

trend-chart.note: axes plus line; fine at all sizes

valve.note: opposed triangles with stem; tight at 16 px but recognizable
